title: Integrality of weak limits of 0-dimensional integer multiplicity currents
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and X_j, X ∈ D_0(U) with every X_j integer multiplicity, sup_j M_W(X_j) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and X_j ⇀ X. Then X is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Xj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U 0) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Xj j)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ j, (Xj j).massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Xj X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X
